function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child‑safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.002 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Texas Transportation Code §545.003 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for adults.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.004 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Yield” signs give priority to the vehicle already in the intersection. | Texas Transportation Code §545.005 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during rain, fog, or low visibility.
• Fog lights only when visibility is ≤ 200 ft. | Texas Transportation Code §545.006 | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Towing vehicles must have a tow‑away sign and a red light.
• Towing a vehicle requires a valid license and registration. | Texas Transportation Code §545.007 | | **Parking** | • No parking in front of fire hydrants, on sidewalks, or in no‑parking zones.
• Parking in a handicap space requires a valid permit. | Texas Transportation Code §545.008 | | **School Bus** | • Stop on both sides of the road when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• Do not pass a stopped school bus with flashing red lights. | Texas Transportation Code §545.009 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered and inspected annually.
• Failure to register can result in fines and impoundment. | Texas Transportation Code §545.010 | | **Insurance** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 bodily injury per person, $60,000 per accident, $25,000 property damage. | Texas Transportation Code §545.011 | | **Special Rules** | • “No‑stop” zones: no stopping, standing, or parking.
• “No‑passing” zones: no overtaking. | Texas Transportation Code §545.012 | ### How to Stay Updated - **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website: [https://www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) - **Texas Transportation Code** – Full text available online via the Texas Legislature’s website. - **Local County Courts** – For specific local ordinances or recent changes. ### Quick Tips 1. **Always check posted signs** – they can override general rules. 2. **Use hands‑free** – even if you’re just listening to music. 3. **Keep your insurance documents in the car** – you may need them in an accident. 4. **Know the school‑zone speed limits** – they’re often lower than the posted limit. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular situation!
